scenes.headline: How to fill a JSON schema without typing it
scenes.sub: Parallel constrained decoding: gather the legal values' logits, renormalize.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Oat! Parallel constrained decoding fills every field of a JSON schema at once, without typing a single brace. Here's how.

scenes.text: A decoder already scores the whole vocabulary at every position. To fill a field, keep only its legal values' rows and renormalize. No training needed.
scenes.mark: keep only its legal values' rows
scenes.say: The idea: a decoder already scores its whole vocabulary at every position. To fill a field, keep only its legal values' rows, and renormalize. No training.

steps.say: Run the schema and the context through the decoder once. Every layer's keys and values land in a cache.
Each field appends the few tokens that open its value onto that same cached prefix. Every field goes in one batch.
Take each field's last hidden state, and push it through the LM head the model already has: one logit per vocabulary entry.

steps.note: risk_level: HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW or NONE
steps.say: Keep only the rows for the legal values: high, medium, low and none. Drop every other row.
Softmax over just those, and take the winner. Its probability comes along as a confidence, for free.

scenes.title: Typing it out, or reading it off

left.title: Type the JSON
items: One forward pass per token, 150 to 500
Each field sees the ones before it
A brace or comma can break
left.say: Typing JSON takes a forward pass per token, and a brace can break. But each field sees the ones before it.

right.title: Parallel constrained decoding
items: Fields can't see each other's answers
right.say: Reading values off the logits is fast, and valid by construction. The price: every field is scored from one snapshot, so fields can't see each other.

scenes.label: enum fields in one repo's shipped presets
scenes.say: One catch: the gather reads only each value's first token. Values that share one, like tier one and tier two, can't be told apart. Five of forty preset fields collide.

scenes.text: Valid syntax comes free from logits you already compute. Correct and calibrated answers do not.

recap: Prefill once; one short suffix per field
Gather the legal values' logits, renormalize
Valid by construction; fields scored independently
scenes.say: To recap: prefill once, gather the legal values, renormalize, and remember that valid is not the same as right.
